description: This file defines the RGraph library's rose chart component, including its constructor, background drawing, and data rendering methods. It is part of the RGraph charting package, providing functionality for rose (polar) charts with options for 3D effects, background grids, labels, and interactivity.

classes.name: RGraph.Rose
classes.description: Constructor for creating rose (polar) charts with configurable properties, drawing methods, and interactivity.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Setter method for chart properties, supports object style configuration.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Main method to render the rose chart, including background, segments, labels, and effects.

methods.name: drawBackground
methods.description: Draws the background grid and axes for the chart.

methods.name: drawRose
methods.description: Draws the rose (polar) data segments based on the data provided.
